body_lead: Patna: Bihar government has signed Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with several major technology companies as well as with IIT Patna for projects and investments worth Rs 468 crore at the ongoing India AI Impact Summit and Expo 2026, New Delhi. 10,000 Jobs, 50,000 Trainees This initiative is expected to create over 10,000 new job opportunities in the field of emerging technologies. Additionally, more than 50,000 youth will receive skill development training through AI-linked programmes.
